{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check the filter
print(f"Total rows after filtering: {len(filtered_df)}")
print(f"QA orders removed: {900 - len(filtered_df)}")
print(f"Refunded orders filtered: {df['status'].value_counts()['refunded']}")

# Confirm the remaining rows are only completed and non-QA
print(filtered_df['status'].value_counts())
print(filtered_df['revenue_clean'].describe())"}
